scenes.title: Growing tiles
scenes.problem: Growing tiles: positions 1–4 have outputs 5, 8, 11, 14. Rule A is 3n + 2; Rule B is 4n + 1. Which rule fits all positions, and what does it predict at position 5?
actions: Align positions 1–4 with their outputs 5, 8, 11, 14; both proposed rules agree at position one.
Calculate the outputs predicted by Rule A (3n + 2) and Rule B (4n + 1) at position 2.
At position 2, Rule B predicts 9, but the given output is 8; reject that rule.
Rule A fits all four outputs. Use it at position 5: T(5) = 17; check again at positions 1 and 4.
scenes.memo: Rule A: 3n + 2. At n=2, reject Rule B (9 ≠ 8). T(5)=17; check T(1)=5 and T(4)=14.
scenes.misconception: Rule B agrees at position one but fails at position 2.
